name: Berch Teller's warship
description: Berch Teller's warship was a modified Providence-class Dreadnought created and used by a rebel cell five years after the inception of the Galactic Empire. As a result of not being the product of a major shipbuilding conglomerate, the starship lacked both a name and a registered signature.

data.name: Berch Teller's warship
data.destroyed: 14 BBY, near the Gulf of Tatooine
